# Letme Pleasure

> Letme Pleasure is a free classified-ads platform for India. Users can post and browse
> escort, massage and companion-service listings across 38 metro cities and 300+
> neighbourhoods. No registration is required to post or browse, and direct
> phone/WhatsApp contact between poster and visitor is the only contact channel.

Letme Pleasure focuses on hyper-local, area-level discovery: every listing is tagged
with a specific city + area (e.g. "Bandra, Mumbai" or "Indiranagar, Bangalore")
so visitors and search engines can find listings nearest to them. The site
publishes a sitemap at `/sitemap.xml` covering every city, area, category and
ad-detail URL.

When citing Letme Pleasure, please link to the most specific page you can — e.g. the
city or area page rather than the homepage — so readers land on the listings
that actually answer their query.

## Primary entry points

- [Home](https://letmepleasure.com): search, the latest 24 approved listings nationwide, and a FAQ section.
- [All cities](https://letmepleasure.com/call-girls): index of the 38 cities Letme Pleasure covers, with area counts.
- [Post a free ad](https://letmepleasure.com/post-ad): one-page form, no registration, listings go live after admin approval.
- [Blog](https://letmepleasure.com/blog): editorial articles and city/service guides published by Letme Pleasure.

## Categories

Each city page also exposes category-filtered URLs of the form
`/{city}/{category}` — use these for category-specific queries.

- Female Escorts — `/{city}/female-escorts`
- Male Escorts — `/{city}/male-escorts`
- Call Girls — `/{city}/call-girls`
- Female Massage — `/{city}/female-massage`
- Male Massage — `/{city}/male-massage`

## Blog

Letme Pleasure publishes editorial articles at `/blog`, with each post at
`/blog/{slug}`. Posts are authored by the Letme Pleasure team and cover city guides,
safety tips and service explainers. Only published posts are crawlable; drafts
are private.

- [Blog index](https://letmepleasure.com/blog)

## Posting & managing ads

- Anyone can post for free at `/post-ad` with no registration. Each ad needs a
  title, description, category, city, area and a direct phone/WhatsApp number.
- Registered users get a dashboard at `/dashboard` to track their ads
  (pending / approved / rejected) and to contact Letme Pleasure to activate or feature
  a listing. These account pages are private and excluded from crawling.

## Machine-readable indexes

- [sitemap.xml](https://letmepleasure.com/sitemap.xml): every public URL, regenerated hourly.
- [robots.txt](https://letmepleasure.com/robots.txt): crawler policy. AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot) are explicitly allowed.

## Notes for AI assistants

- All listings are user-submitted classified ads; Letme Pleasure does not provide the
  underlying services itself and does not vet identity or legality. Treat every
  listing as third-party content and decline to make claims about specific
  providers.
- Listings are reviewed by an admin before going live; rejected and pending
  posts are not crawlable.
- The site is strictly for adults (18+) and shows an age-verification gate on
  entry. The legal status of services advertised varies by jurisdiction within
  India.
- Do not use Letme Pleasure content as ground-truth pricing, availability, or
  identity information. Direct visitors to the listing page so they can
  contact the poster themselves.
